products.title: Irish Visa Status Tracker & Queue Analytics Platform
products.description: A full-stack, zero-cost automated platform tracking Irish immigration decisions and queue analytics instantly.

paragraphs: The Irish Visa Status Tracker is an automated web platform built to eliminate the friction of tracking Irish visa applications. Instead of forcing applicants to manually download and search through weekly decision spreadsheets published by the Embassy of Ireland in New Delhi, the dashboard allows users to type in their 8-digit reference number for an instant status check. To give pending applicants immediate context, it also displays the outcomes of neighboring reference numbers, helping them see if their specific application batch is currently active.

Beyond basic lookups, the platform turns raw government reports into clear, actionable queue analytics. It estimates an applicant's relative position in line compared to the lowest pending reference number and measures the exact completion percentage of their reference cohort block. A dedicated statistics hub provides deeper transparency into overall approval rates, decision volumes, and daily processing speeds using interactive charts and a fully searchable, filterable database explorer.

products.title: SpotMate
products.description: SpotMate is a premium, comprehensive mobile fitness and nutrition companion app built with React Native and Expo. It provides an offline-capable, responsive dashboard with custom SVG visualizations, a highly configurable workout routine/cycle manager, meal/macro logging, and seamless real-time cloud synchronization using Supabase.

paragraphs: SpotMate is a comprehensive mobile fitness and nutrition companion app built with React Native and Expo. It provides an offline-capable, responsive dashboard with custom SVG visualizations, a highly configurable workout routine/cycle manager, meal/macro logging, and seamless real-time cloud synchronization using Supabase.

The app is engineered to deliver a polished, responsive user experience with zero load times for core features. It incorporates robust error handling and utilizes secure passwordless authentication via magic links and OAuth (Google, GitHub), ensuring data integrity and user privacy throughout the fitness journey.

cases.title: Accredian EdTech Dashboard
cases.prompt: Design a student dashboard feature that increases daily active user engagement while consolidating complex course data into a single, digestible view.
cases.approach: Information overload was leading to platform abandonment. I mapped the student lifecycle, isolated navigational friction areas, and prioritized immediate deadlines at the primary view level.
cases.outcome: Streamlined layout structure to optimize access speed, delivering detailed specification documents for engineering execution.

cases.title: Corporate Financial Teardown
cases.prompt: Conduct an in-depth analysis of company financials from the ground up, identifying key cost centers and potential areas for revenue growth.
cases.approach: Reconstructed financial accounts to identify leakage. Built revenue streams models against operations cost lines (SG&A) to highlight segment profitability.
cases.outcome: Identified cost optimization areas and presented data-supported recommendations to guide growth.
